title: Browser: sign-in popups finish (Sign in with GitHub, SSO)
notes: Follow-up to #341 (browser mode). A page's window.open for a sign-in ("Sign in with GitHub", most SSO buttons) opens as a new tab with no window.opener, so a site that hands the sign-in back through the opener never finishes (docs/browser/README.md Open questions). Make the popup keep its opener: build the popup's view from the webContents Electron creates for window.open (setWindowOpenHandler with createWindow / overrideBrowserWindowOptions, or the WebContentsView equivalent), in the same partition, shown as a tab the user can see and close; when the site closes it (window.close), the tab goes. All through the browser actions (actions-rule-1); frameNavigation and browser-rule-1 unchanged. Test the decision parts; list the hand check (sign in with GitHub on a real site) in the PR. Move the item out of Open questions in docs/browser.

comments.body: Runs alongside card fcd6c123 (dashboard browser command), which also changes src/main/actions/browser/ and browser-views.ts. Keep your change to the popup path; merge main in when the other lands.
